description: Fixed context for original ExpressionTests rows whose expressions name declarations that cases.csv does not supply.
ExpressionTests does not record the Python environment used for these rows, so each value below is a fixture choice made for this suite.
The generator never derives these definitions from recorded outputs. RoboChart library names (for example size) come from library imports and must not be declared here.
Rows that RoboChart cannot express, whatever the context (for example matrix used as an identifier, pkg::value as a constant, or TRUE as a literal), have no fixture.

obj.note: A one-field record constant for obj.value; the field value 4 is a fixture choice.

items.note: A three-element integer sequence shared by the first- and last-index rows; size comes from sequence_toolkit.

add.note: Integer addition, as the function name states.
functions: function add(x : int, y : int) : int { postcondition result == x + y }

answer.note: A constant zero-parameter function; the value 42 is a fixture choice.

Color.note: An enumeration containing red and two other literals, so that the observed literal is not the type's only value.
